_about: Standing lean of each policymaker RELATIVE TO THEIR OWN COMMITTEE in the current cycle. Hand-assessed; edit freely. lean: hawk|dove|neutral. confidence: high = votes or explicit repeated calls; medium = recent remarks plus tracker; low = little evidence or a consensus body. vote: the person's voting status, hand-kept (FOMC rotation changes every January).
